facts.value: Throughout this program, you’ll take a set of information technology-focused STEM and core, general education and focus area courses for a balanced, well-rounded curriculum.

facts.value: You’ll explore topics from information system security to advanced systems configuration.

facts.value: There’s also the opportunity to explore the latest artificial intelligence research and developments to understand how you can use and work with this technology in the workforce to best support your career.
